notes: Main line: Li alloy fillers cast from DOL-DME form a Li-rich RCOO-Li/LiF shell (FTIR, XPS) seen as a ~15-25 nm amorphous interface layer (TEM/HRTEM) with a Li gradient into PEO (EELS); the back-calculated interface conductivity is ~10x that of Si/SiO2 interfaces, so total conductivity is highest (~4e-5 S/cm at 30 C), giving stable Li|Li and LFP|Li cells. Control branch: all fillers lower PEO crystallinity (XRD, DSC), but Si/SiO2 barely raise sigma, so the paper weighs the SEI pathway over the low-crystallinity interface (causes mode alternative). Side: t_Li+ 0.43, anodic window, 5 wt% optimum with agglomeration and percolation limits (F6 model). Packet/figure issues: F7c ranks capacity 60 > 45 > 30 C, reverse of the text order 149.7/140.9/129.2 at 30/45/60 C (audit a3); F4b Li gradient ~100-120 nm beyond the Si edge vs text 50-75 nm; F2c PEO powder endotherm ~64 C vs text 60 C; F5b caption '10 mV s-1' for a DC polarization step; t_Li+ 0.43 not reproducible from F5b readings; F7h radar does not show superiority on every axis; F6b Li21Ge5 interface bar slightly above Li21Si5 though text calls Li21Si5-SEI highest; OCR on F7d misread '60 C' as '3.09'; crop F7f OCR letter 'e' disagrees (not cited); caption formulas print Li27Si5 for Li21Si5 (F2a, F3c, F4b, F5d). Supporting figures S1-S14 not in packet.
